# relay_cloud_integration (Resource)

A cloud integration: an IAM role in the customer's AWS account that Relay assumes, for example to export backups to S3. Build the role from `relay_cloud_integration_setup`. After creating the integration, and after changing `role_arn`, the provider asks Relay to assume the role; while IAM is still propagating that fails with a warning, not an error, and `status` stays `pending` or `error` until the integration is tested again from the dashboard. An integration named by a backup auto-export or log stream cannot be deleted while that export or stream exists; destroying `relay_backup_auto_export` deletes the export, so a configuration holding both is destroyed in one run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_cloud_integration_setup" "aws" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "backups" {
  bucket = "acme-relay-backups"
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "relay_backups" {
  name               = "relay-backups"
  assume_role_policy = data.relay_cloud_integration_setup.aws.trust_policy
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "relay_backups" {
  role   = aws_iam_role.relay_backups.id
  policy = replace(data.relay_cloud_integration_setup.aws.permissions_policy, "YOUR_BUCKET", aws_s3_bucket.backups.bucket)
}

resource "relay_cloud_integration" "backups" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  name         = "backups"
  role_arn     = aws_iam_role.relay_backups.arn
}

resource "relay_backup_auto_export" "prod" {
  workspace_id   = relay_workspace.prod.id
  integration_id = relay_cloud_integration.backups.id
  bucket         = aws_s3_bucket.backups.bucket
  prefix         = "prod/"

  depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy.relay_backups]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name, unique in the workspace.
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role Relay assumes. Changing it resets `status` to `pending` and tests the new role.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the integration belongs to.

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider. Only `aws`, the default, is available.

### Read-Only

- `aws_account_id` (String) AWS account the role belongs to.
- `external_id` (String) External ID Relay presents when assuming the role.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `last_error` (String) Why the last role assumption failed, when it did.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `connected` or `error`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_cloud_integration.backups <workspace_id>/<integration_id>
```
